q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

Rashmi was looking for _____ book she had borrowed from the library.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

Rashmi was looking for _____ book she had borrowed from the library.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 2
Articles:
• The: Used for a specific or particular noun.
• A/An: Used for non-specific or general nouns.

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: the (निश्चित/विशिष्ट)
• रश्मि उस विशेष पुस्तक की तलाश कर रही थी जिसे उसने लाइब्रेरी से उधार लिया था।

q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. This strengthens bonds of trust and friendship among individuals.
B. Festivals bring people together, cutting across differences of age and background.
C. They create an atmosphere of joy, sharing and collective celebration.
D. In this way, festivals play a vital role in promoting unity and harmony in society.
E. Community members exchange gifts, prepare food and participate in cultural programmes.
q_hi:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. This strengthens bonds of trust and friendship among individuals.
B. Festivals bring people together, cutting across differences of age and background.
C. They create an atmosphere of joy, sharing and collective celebration.
D. In this way, festivals play a vital role in promoting unity and harmony in society.
E. Community members exchange gifts, prepare food and participate in cultural programmes.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 4
Logic:
• B introduces the theme (festivals).
• C describes the atmosphere they create.
• E details specific activities.
• A shows the result of those activities.
• D concludes the paragraph.

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: B–C–E–A–D
• त्योहारों के महत्व से शुरू होकर एकता के निष्कर्ष तक का सही तार्किक क्रम यही है।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

He is _____ honest person and always speaks the truth.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.

He is _____ honest person and always speaks the truth.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 1
Article Rule:
• 'An' is used before words starting with a vowel sound.
• 'Honest' starts with a silent 'h', so it has a vowel sound (o).

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: an (स्वर ध्वनि के लिए)
• 'Honest' का उच्चारण 'ओ' से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'an' का प्रयोग होगा।

q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first sentence (1) is in the correct order, the sentences below it are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

1. Innovation is the cornerstone of long-term business success.
A. While many companies adapt, companies that fail to evolve quickly fall behind.
B. It allows businesses to adapt to changing consumer demands and market trends.
C. So, many leading firms invest heavily in research and development to stay ahead.
D. As a result, innovation is not just encouraged but considered a survival strategy.
q_hi:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first sentence (1) is in the correct order, the sentences below it are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

1. Innovation is the cornerstone of long-term business success.
A. While many companies adapt, companies that fail to evolve quickly fall behind.
B. It allows businesses to adapt to changing consumer demands and market trends.
C. So, many leading firms invest heavily in research and development to stay ahead.
D. As a result, innovation is not just encouraged but considered a survival strategy.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 1
Sentence Ordering:
• 1 (Intro) → B (Purpose of innovation) → C (Action taken by firms) → A (Comparison/Risk) → D (Final result).

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: B, C, A, D
• नवाचार के महत्व से शुरू होकर इसके व्यावसायिक रणनीति बनने तक का सही क्रम।

q_en:

q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

_____ Sun is the main source of energy for life on Earth.
solution:

Article Rule:

q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

_______ you make the choice to step away from the rush of life and decide to work on yourself, it is going to take some effort.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 4
Usage:

q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below. While the first part is in the correct place, the remaining parts (labelled P, Q, R and S) are jumbled up. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent sentence.

(O) The Indian economy
(P) especially in the service sector
(Q) contributing significantly to the GDP
(R) has shown strong growth
(S) over the past decade
q_hi:
Parts of a sentence are given below. While the first part is in the correct place, the remaining parts (labelled P, Q, R and S) are jumbled up. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent sentence.

(O) The Indian economy
(P) especially in the service sector
(Q) contributing significantly to the GDP
(R) has shown strong growth
(S) over the past decade
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 3
Logical Flow:
• O (Subject) → R (Action/Growth) → S (Time frame) → Q (Impact) → P (Specific area).

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: O R S Q P
• भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था ने पिछले दशक में मजबूत वृद्धि दिखाई है, जो विशेष रूप से सेवा क्षेत्र में GDP में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दे रही है।

q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first sentence (S1) is in the correct order, the sentences below it are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. Globalisation has reshaped economic landscapes worldwide in unprecedented ways.
A. Despite these challenges, globalisation has lifted millions out of poverty through increased opportunities.
B. Although critics argue that it exacerbates income inequality and exploits labour in developing countries.
C. It has facilitated international trade, allowing goods and services to flow more freely.
D. Now, many governments and organisations are working to create policies that balance growth with fairness.
q_hi:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first sentence (S1) is in the correct order, the sentences below it are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. Globalisation has reshaped economic landscapes worldwide in unprecedented ways.
A. Despite these challenges, globalisation has lifted millions out of poverty through increased opportunities.
B. Although critics argue that it exacerbates income inequality and exploits labour in developing countries.
C. It has facilitated international trade, allowing goods and services to flow more freely.
D. Now, many governments and organisations are working to create policies that balance growth with fairness.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 3
Logical Progression:
• S1 (Intro) → C (Direct impact) → B (Criticism/Problem) → A (Counter-point/Benefit) → D (Future solution).

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: C, B, A, D
• वैश्वीकरण के प्रभाव, उसकी आलोचना, लाभ और भविष्य की नीतियों का तार्किक क्रम।

q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. For weeks, he had mapped the stars, measuring time in phases of the moon and fading constellations.
B. It was not just survival anymore — it had become a study of existence itself.
C. What began as simple curiosity turned into a disciplined practice, almost like a ritual.
D. In the absence of clocks and calendars, the sky became both compass and calendar.
q_hi:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. For weeks, he had mapped the stars, measuring time in phases of the moon and fading constellations.
B. It was not just survival anymore — it had become a study of existence itself.
C. What began as simple curiosity turned into a disciplined practice, almost like a ritual.
D. In the absence of clocks and calendars, the sky became both compass and calendar.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 3
Logical Linkage:
• A (Specific action) → D (Reason/Context for A) → C (Evolution of the habit) → B (Final deep meaning).

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: ADCB
• तारों की मैपिंग से शुरू होकर अस्तित्व के अध्ययन तक की यात्रा का वर्णन।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

Yash sailed across _____ Atlantic Ocean to reach Europe.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

Yash sailed across _____ Atlantic Ocean to reach Europe.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 2
Grammar Rule:
• Always use the definite article 'the' before the names of oceans (Atlantic, Pacific, etc.).

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: the (महासागरों के नाम के लिए)
• 'Atlantic Ocean' एक महासागर का नाम है, इसलिए इससे पहले 'the' लगेगा।
